steps.q: Does it make a great product or service?

views.text: In November 2025, a guest on Equity Mates described Centuria Capital as an ASX 200 real estate fund manager with about $20 billion of assets across roughly 400 buildings and seven sectors, offering listed REITs and about 130 unlisted funds, including single asset and open ended portfolios.

episode.title: The $20 billion commercial property investor - Jason Huljich | Centuria Capital

views.text: In April 2025, Equity Mates noted Centuria managed two ASX-listed REITs in Australia and one in New Zealand, and oversaw around 140 funds, highlighting a broad platform to access office, industrial and other commercial property trends.

episode.title: Office Pain, Industrial Gain: Opportunities in Commercial Property - Jason Huljich | Centuria

steps.q: Will it keep earning above market profits?

views.text: In November 2025, a guest on Equity Mates said Centuria’s platform included the largest sector specific office REIT and the largest sector specific industrial REIT in Australia, indicating significant scale, with about $4 billion in industrial assets and about $2 billion in office assets.
